items.titleZh: 基米，这一年太棒了，从头到尾无懈可击
items.summaryZh: 基米这一年表现完美，值得所有赞誉，大家都很高兴。我们将会努力让你明年更难一些。

media.altZh: 基米，这一年太棒了，从头到尾无懈可击 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: What a year Kimi, faultless from the beginning to the end. So well deserved and very happy for you. We’ll work hard to make it a bit harder for you n...
items.summaryEn:
What a year Kimi, faultless from the beginning to the end. So well deserved and very happy for you. 
We’ll work hard to make it a bit harder for you next year 😘
detailZh:
Kimi，这一年太棒了，从头到尾都完美无缺。这是你应得的，非常为你感到高兴。
我们将努力让你明年更难一些 😘
detailEn:
What a year Kimi, faultless from the beginning to the end. So well deserved and very happy for you. 
We’ll work hard to make it a bit harder for you next year 😘
